a: Up to $150,000 per year for 3 years per US PI; about 8 awards ($1.2M per year total for US projects)
dt: Joint 3-page pre-proposal (white paper) due Nov 18, 2026 by email to AFOSR and via the NSTC system; invited full proposals due Feb 19, 2027
e: Joint US-Taiwan basic research on AI-driven materials discovery, materials and nanostructures for energy-efficient electronic, photonic and quantum information technologies, and quantum geometry in solids. Each pre-proposal pairs a US PI and a Taiwan PI; the US PI must be a US citizen, national or permanent resident in a permanent or tenure-track position at a US university.
f: Air Force Office of Scientific Research (AFOSR/AOARD) and Taiwan NSTC
n: AFOSR-Taiwan NSTC Frontiers in Materials and Nanostructures (2027-2030)
